description: A row of dots that shows the current page in a pager or carousel, with an elongated dot for the active page.
overview:
`PageIndicator` draws one dot per page and widens the active one into a pill. Width and position changes animate with Reanimated. When `count` exceeds `maxVisible`, only a window of dots is shown; the window slides to keep the active dot near the center and the dots at its edges shrink to hint that more pages exist.

It comes in two sizes, `default` and `sm`, and two variants: `default` uses the label color for the active dot and `accent` uses the accent color.
usage:
The component is controlled: pass `count` and the current `index`. Pass `onIndexChange` to make the dots pressable; without it the indicator is display-only. Pressing a dot plays a selection haptic.

The `PageIndicatorSize` and `PageIndicatorVariant` types are also exported.

examples.ManyPages: Twelve pages shown in a sliding window at the start, middle and end.
examples.Interactive: Pressable dots that change the page through `onIndexChange`.

PageIndicator.count: Total number of pages. Nothing renders when it is `0`.
PageIndicator.index: Zero-based index of the current page.
PageIndicator.onIndexChange: Called with the new index when a dot is pressed or an accessibility action is used.
PageIndicator.maxVisible: Most dots shown at once. Defaults to `7`, minimum `3`.
PageIndicator.accessibilityLabel: Label read by screen readers. Defaults to `"Page"`.

accessibility:
- The indicator is a single element with the `adjustable` role, and the dots are not focusable on their own.
- Its value is announced as "2 of 5".
- When `onIndexChange` is set, VoiceOver and TalkBack users swipe up or down to move to the next or previous page.
- Animations respect the system reduce motion setting.
notes: - Uses `bg-label` or `bg-accent` for the active dot and `bg-label-quaternary` for the others; colors follow the system appearance.
